request.query: The degree of the determinant of a polynomial matrix is at most the sum of the column degrees.

items.name: Polynomial.degree_multiset_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (t : Multiset (Polynomial R)),
  t.prod.degree ≤ (Multiset.map Polynomial.degree t).sum

items.name: Polynomial.degree_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i).degree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  (∏ i ∈ s, f i).natDegree ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natDegree

items.name: Matrix.det_matrixOfPolynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → Polynomial R),
  (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).natDegree = ↑i) → (∀ (i : Fin n), (p i).Monic) → (Matrix.of fun i j => (p j).coeff ↑i).det = 1

items.name: eval_det
items.type:
∀ {n : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type u_3} [inst_2 : CommRing R]
  (M : Matrix n n (Polynomial R)) (r : R),
  Polynomial.eval r M.det = (Polynomial.eval ((Matrix.scalar n) r) (matPolyEquiv M)).det

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] {ι : Type u_3} (i : σ) (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → MvPolynomial σ R),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (∏ j ∈ s, f j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (f j)
